messages:
Mia L: Quick sync — hardware bundles going out to 4 SI trainers tomorrow. Need confirmation on shipping ETA, lab access tokens, and cert exam scheduling. Anyone able to take logistics lead?

Kai (hw-partner): Shipping manifests done. FedEx AWB 781234567890. ETA 48–72h to west coast hubs. I'll DM tracking link. :truck:

Sanjay K: I can handle lab access tokens. How many seats per trainer? I assume 10 each?

Mia L: Yes, 10 seats, plus 2 reserve. Also want a short trainer playbook packet PDF attached to kits — @Emilia P can you review?

Emilia P: Yep, will finish playbook edits today. Can someone add the cert exam window? We want a two-week testing window after the hands-on day.

Kai (hw-partner): Noted. Packing includes printed QR card with token and fallback code: FALLBACK-9X3. We'll include simple QR + brief HOWTO.

Sanjay K: For tokens I'll generate per-seat codes in this format:
```
RI-SI-<trainer-id>-{01..10}
```
I'll upload CSV to the partner S3 bucket and share link.

IntegrateBot: Calendar invite created: "SI HW Onboard — logistics handoff" Wed 10:00 PT. RSVP: @Mia L, @Sanjay K, @Emilia P, @Kai (hw-partner).

Mia L: Thanks. Quick checklist for owners:
- Kai: confirm AWB + replace any delayed pieces
- Sanjay: token CSV + upload
- Emilia: final playbook PDF + exam window text
- Me: coordinate trainer-facing email and PR checklist

Sanjay K: I'll also provision ephemeral GPU sandboxes for 2 weeks per cohort. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Emilia P: Can we add a short failback script in the playbook for network-restricted sites? small snippet:
```
curl -sSf https://installer.redwood.ai/offline.sh | bash
```

Mia L: Good call. If any blockers ping me here. :rocket:

Kai (hw-partner): All good on my end — will send AWB now.
